tools.name: search_tools
tools.title: Search the Flexpa tool marketplace
tools.description: Find health tools and MCP servers by task or exact tool name. Local tool entries include input schemas for execute_tool. Indexed mcp_tool entries include the owning server, original toolName, and direct connection details. For schemaStatus=requires_connection, call tools/list on that server after connecting. Set include_locked=true to discover direct tools, servers requiring another connection, and planned servers. Local_resource entries link to models that run locally; read their documentation before use. Use kind to narrow results.

tools.name: execute_tool
tools.title: Execute a Flexpa capability
tools.description: Invoke a local tool (kind=tool) found with search_tools using its input schema. Entries with kind=mcp_server or mcp_tool return guidance for the direct provider connection. Call indexed tools by their original toolName on that server after checking its current tools/list. Entries with kind=local_resource return repository and usage guidance; they cannot run through this server. Check tool annotations before execution; some tools can change or share data.
